# Total Town Car Service

> Over 10,000 rides served. Premium black car, limo, and taxi service serving the Minneapolis–St. Paul (Twin Cities) metro area in Minnesota, USA. Specializing in MSP airport transfers, corporate travel, weddings, prom, concerts, wine and brewery tours, and long-distance trips to Rochester / Mayo Clinic. 24/7 availability with professional, fully licensed chauffeurs and luxury vehicles. 5.0-star rated on Google.

## Business facts

- **Name:** Total Town Car Service (also listed on Google as "MSP Total Town Car Service")
- **Location:** Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
- **Phone:** (612) 999-5382
- **Email:** totaltowncarservice@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://totaltowncar.com
- **Track record:** 10,000+ rides served · 5.0-star rated on Google
- **Hours:** Open 24 hours / 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- **Service area:** Minneapolis, St. Paul, and the entire Twin Cities metro (Edina, Bloomington, Eden Prairie, Minnetonka, Wayzata, Plymouth, Maple Grove, Burnsville, Eagan, Roseville, Hopkins, Richfield, Lakeville, Woodbury, Chanhassen, and surrounding suburbs). Long-distance service to Rochester, MN and Mayo Clinic.
- **Vehicle types:** Sedan (1–3 passengers), SUV (1–6 passengers), Taxi (1–4 passengers). *Passenger van service is temporarily unavailable.*
- **Payment:** Major credit cards, debit cards, cash; corporate invoicing available
- **Booking minimum:** 2 hours in advance for online booking; same-day phone bookings accepted when availability permits
- **Google Business Profile:** https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6565784557959312179

## Pricing (starting rates)

- **Taxi:** from $49 (Twin Cities metro, up to 4 passengers)
- **Luxury Sedan:** from $59 (MSP airport to downtown Minneapolis)
- **SUV:** from $69 (MSP airport to downtown Minneapolis)

Final price depends on distance, vehicle, time of day (night surcharge 7 PM–6 AM), and pickup location. Airport pickups include a $15 fee. All prices are all-inclusive — no hidden fees. Passenger van service is temporarily unavailable; for groups larger than 6, please call (612) 999-5382 for arrangements.

## Common questions, short answers

- **How far in advance to book?** Minimum 2 hours for online. Specialty vehicles (stretch limos, vans for groups) and event-day bookings (prom, wedding): 1–2 weeks recommended.
- **MSP to downtown Minneapolis?** ~12 miles, ~20 minutes typical drive time. Sedan service starts at $59.
- **MSP to Mall of America?** ~3 miles, ~10 minutes. Short-distance flat rates apply.
- **Minneapolis to Rochester / Mayo Clinic?** ~85 miles, ~90 minutes one way. Flat-rate packages available.
- **Cancellation?** Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup. Inside 24 hours, fees may apply.
- **Flight delays?** We monitor flight status and adjust pickup automatically — no rebooking required.
- **Car seats?** Available on request — please specify when booking.
- **Tipping?** Optional. Default suggestion at checkout is 20%; you can adjust.
- **Receipts for business?** Yes — emailed automatically after every booking.
